basic_info.main_problem: 因深夜学习时频繁加餐导致体重增加，进而影响自尊与整体幸福感
basic_info.core_demands: Hopes to find healthier stress management and coping mechanisms, reduce the weight gain caused by late-night extra meals, and improve self-esteem and overall well-being
growth_experiences: Several months ago the course load clearly intensified, and she began studying at night more frequently; almost every night when completing homework or papers she adds food because of stress and fatigue (such as chips, biscuits, pizza), and subsequently her weight increased, and self-esteem and interaction with friends were affected; she tried healthier snacks and setting limits, but still finds it hard to control night eating.

core_beliefs: 我在管理生活方面是失败者

special_situations.event: 深夜独自赶论文/学习时感到疲惫与压力，需要保持清醒与专注
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not在夜间持续学习、就without法完成任务；若not通过进食，我就not能保持清醒与效率
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过吃零食（高热量食物）来提神并强行延长学习时间
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我必须吃点东西才能继续专注完成作业

special_situations.event: 与朋友相处或想到社交时，注意到体重增加后感到not自信
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not够有吸引力或体重增加，他们就会看轻我/我not值得被接纳
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduced socializing与分享，保留问题not向朋友求助
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我看起来很糟糕，他们会觉得我not自律

special_situations.event: 夜间学习后发现自己吃了很多高热量零食并关注体重变化
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我without法控制夜间饮食，就说明我缺乏自律，是个失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 自我批评、制定更严格的进食限制（但难以坚持）
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not够自律，我在管理生活方面失败了

special_situations.event: When evaluating the pros and cons of studying at night, mainly focuses on weight gain and negative effects while ignoring the benefits of improved efficiency and a quiet environment
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 负面后果比正面收获更重要，正面因素not值得被考虑
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 以负面为核心进行判断与决策，进一步Reinforcement对自我的negate
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 夜间学习只会让我发胖，都是坏处

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被接纳与认可，保持自尊与吸引力，同时维持学习效率与掌控感
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被看轻/Being rejected（因为体重增加与not自律），害怕失去对自我与学业的控制
defense_goal: 通过强调效率与必要性来Rationalization夜间加餐以降低羞耻与Anxiety
避免向朋友暴露脆弱以维持表面自尊与安全感
以自我批评促进自我控制、试图弥补“失控”的进食行为

object_relations.self_representation: not自信、容易Shame, worry被评价的“失败者/not自律者”
object_relations.object_representation: 可能会看轻自己、对外貌与自律有要求的他人/同伴

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当面临紧迫的学业任务或截止日期，需要在深夜保持清醒与效率时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为只有通过吃零食才能维持专注与完成任务，否则就会失败
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以理性辩解的语气为夜间加餐寻找“必要性”的理由，强调效率与必须性，弱化负面影响；若被质疑，use“必须、not得not”这类词语。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被询问是否向朋友/支持系统分享体重困扰或想到在社交中暴露脆弱时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为一旦暴露问题就会被看轻、尴尬，最好独自承受以避免伤害
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气谨慎、含蓄，简短回应并快速Displacement话题至学习与任务，避免深入表达羞耻与脆弱感。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在回顾夜间进食后体重增加的证据与自我表现时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将自我价值与体重/自律直接挂钩，给自己贴上“失败者”的负性标签
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气低落、use自责式表述（如“都是我not行”），Reinforcement自我批评，放大过失，弱化成功。

以外在效率标准界定自我价值，忽略身体与情感需要

contact_model.definition: The individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: not向朋友寻求支持，将压力与Anxiety转向自己处理
通过夜间加餐与自我批评来消化压力

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.

安静的夜间环境与可获得的零食
